html:
Experience the Essence Grand cruise through Bo Hon Island, visitors will be amazed by the beauty and pass through Soi Sim Island, Ti Top Island, Sung Sot Cave, Luon Cave… where the majestic scenery and nature create a poetic picture.

From Bo Hon Island, it will take visitors more than 1 hour to reach Bai Chay scenic area, an indispensable destination in the Ha Long cruise tour.

It can be said that Bo Hon Island is one of the most beautiful islands in Ha Long Bay, the most beautiful destination in the summer Ha Long travel itinerary, surrounded by steep cliffs, visitors on the cruise will admire the immense beauty of the sea and islands.

In addition, when exploring the beauty of Bo Hon Island, visitors will visit mysterious caves such as: Trong Cave, Luon Cave, Trinh Nu Cave and Sung Sot Cave, which are indispensable destinations in the Ha Long travel itinerary of visitors.

Not only that, when experiencing Ha Long cruise to Bo Hon island, visitors can also visit animals such as monkeys and deer or orchids and Benjamin fig trees on the island, beautiful will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

So let’s go with Vietlook Travel to Ha Long tour to visit Hon Bo island to visit, explore interesting things on the island, and visit mysterious caves, especially experience on Essence Grand cruises at sea, is the most interesting thing that Ha Long brings to visitors.
